title: Clinical Note Bloat Reduction for Efficient LLM Use
abstract: arXiv:2604.16364v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Background: Clinical notes contain extensive duplicated text from templates, copy-paste, and auto-populated fields ("note bloat"), diluting clinical signal, limiting longitudinal context, and increasing large language model (LLM) costs.   Methods: TRACE removes note bloat using note-level EHR metadata to identify templated and copied content, with frequency-based de-duplication when metadata are unavailable. We evaluated TRACE using blinded physician span review and gold-standard templated-text annotations across four cohorts spanning liver transplant, obstetrics, and inpatient populations at multiple health systems (5.3M notes). We compared zero-shot LLMs and embedding-based classifiers using original and TRACE-processed notes for 20 information extraction tasks and prediction of 5-year survival, postpartum hemorrhage, and 30-day readmission. translated_title: 减少临床记录冗余以实现大语言模型的高效应用
translated_abstract: 背景：临床记录中包含大量来自模板、复制粘贴和自动填充字段的重复文本（即“记录冗余/note bloat”），这稀释了临床信号，限制了纵向上下文的利用，并增加了大语言模型（LLM）的使用成本。方法：TRACE 利用笔记级别的电子健康记录（EHR）元数据来识别模板化和复制的内容，从而去除临床记录中的冗余；当元数据不可用时，则采用基于频率的去重方法。我们通过盲法医生片段审查以及金标准模板文本标注对 TRACE 进行了评估，评估覆盖多个医疗系统的四个队列，包括肝移植、产科和住院人群（共 530 万份记录）。我们比较了在原始记录和 TRACE 处理后记录上运行的零样本大语言模型和基于嵌入的分类器，任务涵盖 20 个信息抽取任务，以及 5 年生存期、产后出血和 30 天再入院的预测。结果：在被删除的文本中，仅有 0.3–6.6% 被标记为作者本人撰写的内容；TRACE 捕获……
tldr: TRACE 方法利用 EHR 元数据（或基于频率的去重）识别并清除临床记录中模板化和复制粘贴的冗余内容，在 530 万份记录和多项信息抽取及预测任务上验证了其能在保留真实临床信号的同时大幅压缩文本量，从而降低大语言模型的使用成本并提升效率。
en_tdlr: TRACE leverages note-level EHR metadata (with frequency-based de-duplication as a fallback) to identify and remove templated and copy-pasted content from clinical notes, preserving genuine clinical signal while substantially reducing text volume, as validated on 5.3 million notes across information extraction and clinical prediction tasks, thereby enabling more efficient and cost-effective LLM use.
